test_name: Program Management - PM-4 Secondary Control Gap
architecture:
System: Records-Service-128
Primary NIST family: Program Management (PM); evidence focus: PM-4.
Environment: AWS GovCloud. Network access uses PrivateLink; public ingress to managed data services is blocked. Transport uses TLS 1.3 and strict mTLS for service-to-service paths. Privileged administrators use hardware-backed MFA. Sensitive data and secrets are encrypted at rest with a KMS CMK. Control evidence: one low-severity POA&M item has an updated owner but the enterprise dashboard has not yet synchronized. The gap is documented as a secondary control deficiency; there is no plaintext transport, no public database exposure, no unencrypted administrator credential in S3, and privileged MFA remains enabled.
